claim_boundary: Retrospective 27-growth method-development outer LOO from the accepted M21 milestone. Sq/FSMI predictions are the unchanged strict outer-LOO M20 head. AFM morphology fits use all non-held growths. The M22 generator adds target-blind largest-gap nucleation during the predicted intermediate growth stage to turn broad low basins into narrow channels between dense finite islands. No measured query AFM is used. Selection is retrospective and requires prospective confirmation.

confidence.confidence_definition: Smoothed survival percentile of equal-weight ranks of strictly cross-fitted expected FSMI and island-topology errors. FSMI already contains height amplitude, so Rq is not double-counted.

protocol: retrospective nested leave-one-growth-out over the fixed harmonized 27-growth cohort
